reviews.comment: The class mainly relied on participation questions and weekly quizzes. The exams were straightforward and often used the same questions as the quizzes. As long as you watched the lectures and had a good grasp of the concepts taught, you should be fine in this class.

This was an online class which consisted of a participation grade and quiz almost every week and discussions every once and awhile. The professor was really good and he seemed to be passionate about what he was teaching through his videos. Highly recommend taking this class with Professor Sparks.

Dr. Spark's class was very organized and structured. The exams were fair and aligned with the quizzes, and the only assignments outside of exams and quizzes were activity quizzes based on the lecture modules and discussion posts. He was a very kind professor and genuinely cared for his students. An A in this class will be easily achievable.
